summary: Linn County L-4 ground cab built 1949, dismantled in 1969, and the cab moved to Green Peter Lookout in 1970. No source describes the site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts dates the Jordan lookout's dismantling to 1969, and the register and firelookout.com date the L-4 cab's move to Green Peter to 1970. Both can hold: the tower was taken down in 1969 and the cab reached Green Peter in 1970. Both dates are kept.

notes_for_editor: Build year 1949 and the cab's move to Green Peter in 1970 are well supported. The dismantling year is 1969 in Forest Lookouts and the Green Peter history, so the cab move and the tower removal are kept as separate dates. The brief's height_m 4.3 is not supported by any page read here, so it is not carried into facts; please check its origin. The brief's access 'unknown' is kept as unknown; no source gives access for the Jordan site. No staffing or fire history was found for Jordan. A search returned a cherylhill.net Linn Forest Protective Association category page that was not read; it may describe the Jordan site today. Green Peter's present condition rests on the register's undated note and the local record's 'standing' status, so the story reports the register's wording only.
